title: Six AND Gates Beat Seven: A Counterexample to Quadratic-Circuit Optimality over F2
description: An explicit homogeneous quadratic map Q: F26 → F25 with multiplicative complexity 6 over XOR–AND circuits, while every quadratic (level-one) circuit for Q needs 7 AND gates. Both bounds are exact, proved by hand and confirmed by an exhaustive verifier (verify.py). To the best of our knowledge, this gives a negative answer to the general question of quadratic-circuit optimality raised by Mirwald and Schnorr (1992) and revisited by Boyar and Find. Research note; not peer-reviewed.
